RIKA_POWER.title: Rika
RIKA_POWER.description:
100 HP. While present, gain 2 additional Energy each turn. Vanishes after 5 turns.
The amount is the number of turns Rika remains.
WHICH_ONE_YUTA_POWER.title: Yuta, Which One?
WHICH_ONE_YUTA_POWER.description: While Rika is present, at the start of each turn choose 1 of 3 cards from other characters and add it to your hand. It costs 0 that turn.
